description_en: After a database is created, you can create a database account for it. After the account is created, O&M engineers can use the account to log on to and manage the database
description_zh: 数据库创建成功后，您可以为其新建数据库账户。创建成功后，运维员可以使用该账号登录并运维数据库
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost create-database-account --instance-id bastionhost-cn-5yd34ol020a --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-id 3 --database-account-name root --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabaseAccount

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host instance for which you want to create a database account.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要新建数据库账户的堡垒机实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host for which you want to create a database account.
For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
要新建数据库账户的堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the database for which you want to create an account.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html operation to query this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要创建账户的数据库实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758839.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: database_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the database account to create. The name can be up to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 指定新创建数据库账户的名称。最多支持128字符
parameters.name: database_account_name

parameters.help_en: The password of the database account to create
parameters.help_zh: 指定新建数据库账户的密码
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en: The database name. This parameter is required when the database corresponding to DatabaseId is PostgreSQL or Oracle
parameters.help_zh: 数据库名。当DatabaseId对应的Database为Postgres和Oracle时，DatabaseSchema为必填
parameters.name: database_schema

parameters.help_en:
The logon attribute. This parameter is required for Oracle databases. Valid values:
SERVICENAME
SID
parameters.help_zh:
登录属性，Oracle类型数据库必须指定，取值：
SERVICENAME
SID
parameters.name: login_attribute

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
